edge_cases.description: Real .github/workflows/ci.yml unreadable or empty (/dev/null mount) in runner
Real ci.yml still unpinned before the maintainer applies the patch must not break CI, and must not XPASS-fail after it is applied
Handed-off file with no uses: lines would vacuously pass
uses: lines both as list item (- uses:) and as continuation key under - if:
Hand-off test silently skips if the job folder is pruned later
